digest.component_or_area: rebar search command and library interface
propositions: rebar search currently returns full ticket bodies including descriptions and all comments, consuming excessive context for discovery operations
search command lacks an --output flag and rejects --output json as an unknown option rather than recognizing it as a valid format selection
default search results must be reduced to eight fields (ticket_id, alias, title, ticket_type, status, priority, summary, snippet) with summary and snippet each capped at 240 characters

snippet extraction must locate the first matching positive free-text search term case-insensitively and return a bounded, case-preserving context window that may originate from description, comment, tag, or identifier without returning full bodies
predicate-only and negation-only queries must return null snippet and null summary respectively in JSON, with LLM output omitting those keys when null
--full flag must restore legacy full TicketState JSON shape while --full --output llm must exit with error code 2 for incompatibility
